headline: Wynn Resorts (WYNN) Could Be 25% Undervalued After Earnings Beat And Buyback Update
summary: Wynn Resorts (WYNN) is back in focus after second quarter 2026 results topped market expectations, with higher revenue and earnings, a fresh dividend, ongoing share repurchases, and updates on its Wynn Al Marjan Island development. See our latest analysis for Wynn Resorts. At a share price of $101.50, Wynn Resorts has seen a 5.35% 1 month share price return while the year to date share price return is down 17.19%, and the 1 year total shareholder return is down 4.47%.
